description:
Anonymize customer PII in the 'chinook_vendor.db' database to prepare it for external sharing. Connect DBeaver to '/home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_vendor.db' (Connection name: 'ChinookVendor').

Update the 'customers' table with the following rules:
- FirstName: Set to literal 'Customer'
- LastName: Set to 'C' followed by CustomerId zero-padded to 3 digits (e.g., 'C007')
- Company: Set to 'REDACTED' if currently present, otherwise leave as NULL
- Address: Set to literal 'REDACTED'
- Phone and Fax: Set to NULL
- Email: Set to 'customer' + CustomerId + '@example.com' (e.g., 'customer7@example.com')

Do NOT modify other columns (City, Country, etc.). Verify referential integrity remains intact.

Generate an audit report CSV at '/home/ga/Documents/exports/anonymization_report.csv' with columns: Field, Action, RecordsAffected (7 rows for the 7 modified fields). Save your SQL script to '/home/ga/Documents/scripts/anonymize_customers.sql'.
